_about: Working Holiday (417/462) schools: owner 25 Nov 2026 (WEI-WHV-CHARTER-1125) — help Working Holiday Makers enrol with us and send the application to Charter Australia; KCA added as a second option the same day. Facts only from the schools' own files sent to info@. Never put agent commission here.

schools.name: Charter Australia
schools.city: North Sydney campus, or online from any state
schools.summary: Aged care, hospital and childcare Certificate III courses in their Study and Work Program for Working Holiday Makers, with work placement arranged by Charter.
points: Study at the North Sydney campus, in live online evening classes, or self-paced on Charter's E-Campus (not for primary student visa holders).
If you live in another state you can study the theory online. Placement for interstate students can have extra conditions.
Charter arranges the work placement (160 hours for childcare).
Intakes run almost every week or term, so you can start soon.
fees: CHC33021 Certificate III in Individual Support
English for Healthcare and Nursing + CHC33021
HLT33115 Certificate III in Health Services Assistance
English for Healthcare and Nursing + HLT33115
CHC30125 Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care
fee_notes: Application fee A$300 (non-refundable). Before you start: A$1,500 first payment + the application fee + material fees.
Childcare special prices run until 30 June 2027.
Charter lists each program as up to 12 months. Your offer letter shows your real dates and fees.
schools.source: Charter Australia 2027 fee table for Study and Work Program students (published 24 July 2026) and Charter's course update to us (10 September 2026). Charter can change fees; the offer letter is final.
options: Charter: CHC30125 Early Childhood Education and Care (childcare)
Charter: English first, then one of these

schools.name: KCA Education
schools.legal: Learning Lab Pty Ltd, trading as KCA Education
schools.city: Brisbane campus (Eight Mile Plains), or online from anywhere in Australia
schools.summary: A 16-week aged care and disability course for Working Holiday Makers: 12 weeks of class and 4 weeks of work placement.
points: CHC33021 Certificate III in Individual Support (Ageing and Disability), open to 417 and 462 visa holders.
16 weeks: 12 weeks of study, then 4 weeks of work placement (at least 120 hours).
Classes Monday to Thursday, 9 am to 4 pm Brisbane time, at the Brisbane campus or online.
KCA arranges placement at no extra cost in Sydney or Brisbane / Gold Coast. Placement is in person.
Before placement you need a National Police Check, a First Aid certificate and a COVID-19 vaccination certificate.
Entry: Year 10 or higher, and IELTS 5.5 or KCA's free English placement test.
fee_notes: Full payment before the course starts.
If you apply now, the price in your offer letter applies, even for a 2027 intake. Accept the offer before it expires by paying the deposit it shows.
KCA publishes 2027 intake dates and prices near the end of 2026. Ask us for the next start date.
schools.source: KCA Education's course details for agents, sent to us on 30 September 2026.
schools.warn: 16 weeks is close to the 4-month study limit on a Working Holiday visa. If you have already studied on this visa, the course may not fit: ask a registered migration agent before you apply.
options: KCA: CHC33021 Individual Support (aged care, 16 weeks)
